title: Simple Toxin
summary: Coat weapons or throw to apply delayed Poison damage.

fields.Coat: Bonus Action, single use. Coat the active weapon set for 10 turns. Replaces an existing dip or coating. On a qualifying hit, DC 11 Constitution save prevents 1d4 Poison at the end of the target’s next turn. One target per attack.
fields.Throw: Action up to 60 ft. The immediate blast and 3 ft dippable surface each apply DC 11 Constitution saves against the delayed 1d4 Poison effect. Both can apply. Item lists the surface as 1 turn while the shared table lists permanent.
fields.Alchemy: Extract three Bullywug Trumpets into Suspension of Bullywug Trumpet and add any Sublimate.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
